AnimationCurve.description:
Validated, strictly time-ordered document data; evaluation lives in
kronello-animation. Unknown meaning versions can be retained and serialized,
but cannot be edited or evaluated as version 1. Empty curves are editable;
evaluating one is an explicit error, never an implicit default value.

AssetId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

AudioRetimePolicy.description: NLE-001 never performs implicit pitch/speed conversion.

background.description: Explicit opaque background, linear Rec.709 SDR, before BT.709 encoding.

BackendSelection.description: Explicit execution choice. GPU initialization is lazy and never falls back.

BoundsStage.description: Resolution-independent bounds stage selected by a layout consumer.

bytes.description: Retained payload weight, excluding allocator overhead. Values use JSON byte size.

media.description:
Loaded FFmpeg capabilities; discovery failures return a typed error.
An explicitly supplied report avoids runtime initialization.

properties.description: Placement transform and effect parameters, evaluated in sequence time.

volume.description: Absent in M2 documents means unity. Evaluated in source-local time.

hardware.description: FFmpeg HARDWARE or HYBRID registration; device success is checked on open.

ColorComponents.description:
Straight RGB with independent alpha. Alpha defaults only at input; saved
colors always emit all four components and an explicit color space.

read_only.description:
Read-only refers to the source project: render.sequence and
project.collect write output files without changing that project.

response_schema.description: Successful result value schema (without status/kind envelope).

Composition.description:
Editable document frame. After editing or decoding, validate the complete
definition set with validate_compositions before accepting it. Node storage
order has no semantic meaning; root_nodes and child_order carry draw order.

input_bindings.description:
Targets are properties on the referenced Composition. Curve/expression
metadata resolution and public template input policy are later layers.

EditCommand.description:
Externally tagged commands decode directly, retaining strict fields and
concrete model number decoding instead of serde's tagged Content buffer.

Effect.description: Unknown ids, parameters, fields and variants are retained verbatim.

oneOf.description: An injected backend has no known resource/transfer contract.

audio_codecs.description: AAC is omitted until its export contract is adopted.

nodes.description: Ordered postorder tree; the last node is the root. No sharing or dead nodes.

oneOf.description: Seconds in the authored source scope, after its rational time mapping.
Stable property in the authored source scope; None means composition input.
Explicit rational offset; no dynamic property sampling or recursion.
Fixed hash noise in [-1, 1], keyed by seed, instance, element and input.

color.description: Color Property: explicitly tagged straight RGB and independent alpha.

FiniteF64.description: No non-finite value can be constructed or deserialized through the public API.

FontRef.description:
File hash plus face index fixes the actual bytes; names are verified too.
No family lookup or implicit system-font fallback is permitted.

frame_index.description: Decimal absolute time-zero frame index; absent for arbitrary still time.

FrameRate.description: A positive exact number of frames per second.

transform.description: Gradient coordinates to unit coordinates; bbox mapping is applied next.

GradientSpread.description: Versioned paint settings. Missing settings preserve VEC-003 semantics.

base_revision.description: Decimal revision, independent of JSON number precision.

kind.description:
containment_parent / transform_parent / matte / property / shape / text /
font / curve / expression. Parent graphs remain separate.

InstancePath.description:
Root-to-leaf stable placement identities. Empty denotes the root definition.
A path is contextual: resolve it from a root Composition to validate it.

interpolation.description: Applies to [this key, next key). Validated even on the last key.

LayoutValue.description:
Semantic bounds supplied by the upper compiler, without backend objects or
evaluation history. None denotes no geometry at that stage, never a fallback.

MatteBinding.description:
Explicit render inputs until a document-level matte model is implemented.
A consumed matte is removed from display roots/children, unless visible is
true. Keys use stable instance paths, never document-array positions.

MediaNode.description: Explicit media stream; AUDIO-003 executes audio only.

time_map.description: Maps time relative to the owning node's active_range.start.

volume.description: A kronello.audio.volume Property owned by the same SceneNode.

Modifier.description:
Ordered modifier frame only, with semantic parameters and a stable identity.
No modifier algorithm or execution capability is implemented here. The
animation compiler must resolve kind/version and reject unsupported kinds.

ModifierId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

Mutation.description:
Paths use object-member segments, avoiding ambiguous JSON pointer escaping.
An array segment selects an object by its UUID `id`, never by position.
The service replaces ordered arrays (including modifiers and draw order)
as a unit; only unordered model collections use member paths.

mattes.description: Explicit transient matte bindings, using the existing RenderSnapshot contract.

render_diagnostics.description: Full-composition compiler failures are distinct from this node's causes.

NodeKind.description: Content hooks only; geometry, text layout, and rendering are later layers.

Path.description:
A document geometry container only. Topology checking/morph evaluation is
deferred to the vector/animation layer; Path currently supports Hold only.

oneOf.description: Read-only inspection (ADR-0064) read a snapshot without opening a store.

Property.description:
Deserialization checks intrinsic invariants only; use from_json(input,
registry) or validate(registry) to resolve the descriptor before accepting
an imported property. Source catalogs are checked by validate_sources.

samples.description: Request key order; each values array follows request time order.

ProtectedMiddleMode.description: Only the middle is retimed; intro/outro retain unit speed.

plan.description: None on a compiler failure; never substitutes a successful partial plan.

compilation_cache.description: Actual counters for isolated compilation only; raster is not executed.

executed.description: Always false: compilation does not initialize or execute a backend.

output_host_bytes_estimate.description: Two retained full-frame float32 RGBA host outputs, excluding allocator overhead.

index.description: Index local to this tile's DAG, not a document identity.

expected_revision.description: Optional fence against changes since the caller inspected the project.

render.description:

target model. output_directory is the MOV filename for ProResMov.

budget_surfaces_estimate.description: Conservative surface count matching the built-in backend budget formula.

A wire key for either a node property or a composition input. IDs and paths
are the evaluator's runtime identities, never display names or indices.

SampleRate.description: Positive integer samples per second. Indices share the time-zero origin.

child_order.description: Ordered owned children, independent of transform parenting.

enabled.description: Disabled containment subtrees do not enter the evaluated scene.

name.description: Display only; never used as identity.

tags.description: Search metadata only; never runtime identity.

bounds.description: Simultaneous stages in root Composition design_px (before matte clipping).

active_range.description: Authored half-open range in this instance's local composition time.

children.description: Ordered children, with expanded definition roots before authored children.

evaluated.description: Present only for active nodes when evaluation was requested.

nodes.description: Containment pre-order; includes inactive nodes without evaluating values.

range.description: Overlap in each node's authored local composition time, not visibility.

SchemaKey.description:
Immutable namespaced schema identity, such as `kronello.transform.opacity`.
It is supplied by the schema author, independently of a localized label.

bounds.description: Absent legacy snapshots use the initial bounds contract, never latest.

SequenceId.description:
Stable UUID identity, never derived from a display name or array index.
UUID v4 allows independent editing processes to allocate IDs without a
central counter. Allocate once during editing and persist it; ID
generation is not part of deterministic property evaluation.

start_time.description: Absolute PTS origin. Missing legacy metadata means zero, never latest.

StreamingExportReport.description:
Logical I/O observed after successful operations. Stage byte lengths come
from file metadata; they are not physical device I/O or process RSS estimates.

options.description: Absent options retain the exact VEC-003 execution path.

StrokeOptions.description: Explicit opt-in; lengths are local design_px, offset is an evaluated Property.

fill_rule.description: Defines the interior independently of whether the shape has fill paint.

content_hash.description: Hash of the complete reachable authoring content, fixed by define.

definition.description: Effective variant bindings, public schemas, duration and bounds policies.

diagnostic.description: A failed preview is diagnostic data, never a render success.

TemplateVariant.description: Each aspect variant freezes a separate authored Composition and bindings.

line_height.description: Absolute baseline spacing in design_px, not a font-size multiplier.

styles.description: Ordered, nonoverlapping, complete coverage at grapheme boundaries.

TextRange.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte range in the original, unnormalized text.

TimeBezier.description:
Normalized time/value-progress handles between (0, 0) and (1, 1).
Ordered x handles guarantee monotonic time. Finite y handles may overshoot.
These are dimensionless progress values, never stored timestamps.

TimeMap.description:
Exact, stateless mappings. Protected middle segments support hold and loop.
Reverse and general nonlinear playback remain unsupported.

TimeRange.description: A half-open interval [start, end). Equal endpoints describe an empty range.

oneOf.description: Split strictly inside the placement, without implicit linked/transition edits.
Move one placement or its transitive reciprocal link component.

Replace the selected clips' links with one reciprocal group. Old edges
incident to the group are removed at both endpoints.

Shift placements starting at/after pivot on explicit tracks. Reject a
clip straddling pivot. linked=true includes complete link components.

bytes_estimate.description: None means not estimated, rather than zero or a measured value.

assumptions.description: Missing tags are visible assumptions, never inferred from image pixels.

oneOf.description: No semantic hiding cause found; pixel coverage/occlusion is not measured.

VisibilityCode.description: Stable semantic causes, extensible without adding state to the inspector.

error.description: Original typed failure, including expression/cycle/overflow codes.

subject.description: The responsible node; ancestors retain their own instance identity.
